set.body: Port the non-plotting connected-component behavior for surface fields: threshold predicates over SurfaceField[Double], component labels ordered deterministically, component sizes, and cluster-size thresholding. Acceptance: fixtures cover isolated vertices, multiple clusters, all-background, and R-neurosurf tetrahedron-style expectations where applicable; output preserves geometry and indexed values. Likely paths: modules/surface/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/surface/algorithms, modules/surface/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface.
set.title: Surface connected components and cluster thresholding
